_comment: Declared prior exposure for the example curriculum. Each learner's
'encountered' list names taught processes by the code the curriculum graph
The four positions are chosen so that rule R1 has something to say. E2 has
met the operator processes but not selection; E3 has met selection but not
iteration. The same activity therefore sits at Apply for one of them and at
Create for the other, which is the demonstration.

learners.label: Week 1, nothing taught yet
learners.note: Has met no procedure. Every activity asks this learner to assemble something they have not been shown.

learners.label: Week 3, operators covered
learners.note: Arithmetic, relational comparison and flowcharts taught. Selection and iteration not yet.

learners.label: Week 8, selection covered
learners.note: Selection and nesting now taught. Loops still to come.
